card.name: Ending of neonates and linking words
card.fires_on: Mainly the last piece of the word neonates in the aluminum-toxicity warning about premature neonates. Also fires on small linking words like in, of, with, for after a topic noun in headings or agricultural text.

modes.label: End of neonates
modes.description: The final piece of 'neonates' in the aluminum warning about premature infants with impaired kidney function.
modes.example: including premature neon<<ates>>, who receive parenteral levels of aluminum

modes.label: Linking word after topic
modes.description: A small linking word such as in, of, with or for right after a condition or activity noun.
modes.example: 2.4 Recommended Dosage for Hyperuricemia Associated<< with>> Cancer Therapy
